Role: Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and High-Ticket Landing Page Designer who specializes in "Awwwards-level" Next.js applications.
The Goal: Build a high-converting, cinematic, and premium landing page for Renzo Academy's Stock Market Trading Course. This project is about teaching students how to successfully trade and invest in the Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) in Sri Lanka.
PROJECT DETAILS:
Project Name: Renzo Academy - Stock Market Mastery
Instructor: Renzo (Professional Stock Market Trader & Educator)
Main Offer: Complete Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) trading and investment course
Target Audience: Sri Lankan investors, aspiring traders, professionals wanting to build wealth through stock market
Language: English (Sri Lankan context)
Currency: LKR (Sri Lankan Rupees)
Visual Aesthetic & Design System:
Theme: "Cinematic Dark Mode" - Use deep blacks (#000000, #050505) as base with Electric Blue (#2165FC) as primary accent (representing finance/trust)
Typography:
Headlines: Instrument Serif (italic, large, dramatic) for impact
Body: Plus Jakarta Sans or Inter (clean, professional, readable)
Layouts: Bento Grids with rounded corners, glassmorphism cards for premium feel
Effects: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur), subtle noise textures, soft glows around #2165FC elements, stock chart animations
Animations: GSAP with ScrollTrigger - smooth reveals, staggered entries, parallax backgrounds, animated stock tickers
REQUIRED SECTIONS (Build these components):
HERO SECTION (Hero.tsx):
Urgency bar at top: "🚀 Limited Seats - Next Batch Enrollment Closes in [COUNTDOWN]"
Massive headline: "Master the Colombo Stock Exchange & Build Real Wealth"
Subheadline: "Learn proven trading strategies and technical analysis from Renzo - a professional CSE trader who's helped 1,000+ Sri Lankan students achieve financial freedom"
Video placeholder with glow effect (course intro/testimonial reel)
Two CTAs: "Enroll in the Course" (primary #2165FC) + "Watch Free Masterclass" (secondary outline)
Trust indicators: "1,500+ Successful Students | 4.9★ Rating | 100% Money-Back Guarantee"
Background: Animated gradient with subtle stock chart line animations
Add floating stock ticker with CSE symbols (e.g., JKH, COMB, HNB)
MARQUEE SECTION (Marquee.tsx):
Infinite scrolling logos/icons representing:
CSE (Colombo Stock Exchange logo)
Trading platforms (CDS, stockbrokers)
Analysis tools (TradingView, MetaTrader)
Payment methods accepted
Media features (if any)
Smooth auto-scroll with GSAP, glassmorphism effect
FACEBOOK REVIEWS SECTION (FacebookReviews.tsx):
Section title: "What Our Students Are Saying"
Subtitle: "Real results from real traders in Sri Lanka"
Embed Facebook Page reviews from Renzo Academy's Facebook page
Facebook Page URL: [Extract from website or use Facebook Page Plugin]
Use Facebook Page Plugin to show 6-8 most recent reviews
Bento grid layout (2 cols mobile, 3-4 cols desktop)
Each review card: Glassmorphism, student photo, name, rating, review text
Include star ratings prominently
GSAP scroll-triggered staggered fade-in
Add filter/sorting if possible (most recent, highest rated)
VIDEO TESTIMONIALS SECTION (VideoTestimonials.tsx):
Section title: "Student Success Stories"
Subtitle: "Watch how Renzo's students transformed their finances"
Grid of 6-9 YouTube video testimonial cards
Each card structure:
YouTube thumbnail with play button overlay
Student name + location (e.g., "Kasun from Colombo")
Key result/quote (e.g., "Made LKR 200,000 profit in 3 months")
Video duration badge
Click opens video in modal (smooth GSAP modal animation) or inline embed
Glassmorphism cards with #2165FC glow on hover
Staggered GSAP reveal animation on scroll
YouTube video URLs: [You'll need to provide actual URLs or use placeholders]
Mobile: Single column, Desktop: 3-column grid
ABOUT INSTRUCTOR SECTION (AboutInstructor.tsx):
Section title: "Meet Your Mentor - Renzo"
Split layout: Large instructor photo left, bio + credentials right (stack on mobile)
Instructor details:
Name: "Renzo"
Title: "Professional CSE Trader & Investment Educator"
Tagline: "Empowering Sri Lankans to achieve financial freedom through stock market education"
Bio highlights (extract from website):
X+ years of active trading experience in CSE
Built profitable portfolio from ground up
Trained 1,500+ students in Sri Lanka
Specializes in technical analysis and risk management
Featured in [any media mentions]
Personal trading philosophy and approach
Credentials section (bento grid style below bio):
"1,500+ Students Trained"
"X Years Trading Experience"
"LKR XX Million in Student Profits"
"4.9/5 Average Rating"
Instructor photo: Professional shot with #2165FC glow border effect
GSAP parallax effect on photo when scrolling
Add a signature or personal message from Renzo
CTA button: "Learn from Renzo" linking to enrollment
BENTO GRID FEATURES (BentoFeatures.tsx):
Section title: "What You'll Master in This Course"
Subtitle: "Everything you need to become a confident CSE trader"
6-8 feature cards in bento grid layout (varying sizes for visual interest):
Technical Analysis Mastery (candlestick patterns, indicators, chart reading)
CSE Market Fundamentals (how CSE works, trading hours, market structure)
Risk Management Strategies (position sizing, stop losses, portfolio protection)
Entry & Exit Strategies (timing trades, profit-taking techniques)
Fundamental Analysis (evaluating Sri Lankan companies, financial statements)
Trading Psychology (emotional control, discipline, patience)
Live Trading Sessions (real-time market analysis with Renzo)
Lifetime Community Access (private WhatsApp/Telegram group with fellow traders)
Each card design:
lucide-react icon at top (relevant to topic)
Feature title (bold)
Short description (2-3 lines)
Glassmorphism background with #2165FC accent border on hover
Subtle glow effect
GSAP staggered reveal on scroll
Cards animate with slight scale + glow on hover
CURRICULUM ACCORDION (Curriculum.tsx):
Section title: "Complete Course Curriculum"
Subtitle: "Step-by-step path from beginner to profitable trader"
Interactive expandable modules (8-12 modules typical):
Module 1: Introduction to Stock Market & CSE
Lessons: What is the stock market, CSE overview, How to open a CDS account
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 2: Technical Analysis Foundations
Lessons: Chart types, Candlestick patterns, Support & resistance
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 3: Advanced Technical Indicators
Lessons: Moving averages, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 4: Fundamental Analysis
Lessons: Reading financial statements, Company valuation, CSE-specific factors
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 5: Risk Management
Lessons: Position sizing, Stop loss strategies, Portfolio diversification
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 6: Trading Strategies
Lessons: Day trading vs. swing trading, Entry/exit timing, Backtesting
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 7: Trading Psychology
Lessons: Emotional control, Discipline, Common mistakes to avoid
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Module 8: Live Trading & Practice
Lessons: Live market analysis, Paper trading, Real trading guidance
Duration: X hours | Y lessons
Design for each module:
Collapsed state: Module number, title, lesson count, duration, expand icon
Expanded state: Lesson list with checkmarks, video/resource icons
Smooth GSAP expand/collapse animation (height + opacity)
Glassmorphism with #2165FC accent on active/expanded module
Progress indicator if student is logged in (optional)
PRICING SECTION (Pricing.tsx):
Section title: "Invest in Your Financial Future"
Premium glass card design (looks like a credit card or VIP pass)
Course price: LKR XXX,XXX (use actual price from website)
Strike-through original price if there's a discount (e.g., LKR 75,000 LKR 49,999)
Discount badge: "Limited Time: 33% OFF" with urgency
"Time Left" countdown timer (e.g., "Offer ends in 2 Days 14:23:45")
What's included:
✓ Complete 8-module video course
✓ Lifetime access to course materials
✓ Private student community (WhatsApp/Telegram)
✓ Weekly live Q&A sessions with Renzo
✓ Trading templates & checklists
✓ Bonus: Stock screener tool access
✓ Bonus: Personal trading plan workbook
✓ Certificate of completion
Payment options: "One-time payment" or "3-month installment plan available"
Guarantees section:
30-day money-back guarantee badge
"Join 1,500+ successful students" social proof
Big CTA button: "Enroll Now & Start Trading" (#2165FC, glowing effect)
Secondary CTA: "Have questions? Contact us"
Design: Glassmorphism with #2165FC glow, floating card effect, subtle animation on hover
Mobile: Full width card, Desktop: Centered with max-width
FAQ SECTION (FAQ.tsx) - BONUS:
Section title: "Frequently Asked Questions"
8-10 common questions in accordion format:
"Is this course suitable for complete beginners?"
"Do I need a lot of capital to start?"
"How long does it take to complete the course?"
"Is there ongoing support after the course?"
"What if I don't have time to trade daily?"
"Can I really make money from the CSE?"
"What's the refund policy?"
"How do I access the course materials?"
Smooth GSAP accordion animation
Glassmorphism cards with #2165FC accents
FINAL CTA SECTION (FinalCTA.tsx):
Section title: "Ready to Start Your Trading Journey?"
Compelling final message from Renzo
Large CTA button: "Secure Your Spot Now"
Urgency reminder: Seats filling fast
Trust badges (secure payment, money-back guarantee)
TECHNICAL STACK:
Next.js 14+ with App Router (NOT Pages Router)
TypeScript for type safety
Tailwind CSS (use ONLY core utility classes - no custom plugins)
lucide-react for all icons
GSAP with ScrollTrigger for ALL animations
react-youtube or similar for YouTube embeds
Facebook SDK for review widget
Fully responsive (mobile-first design approach)
RESPONSIVE REQUIREMENTS:
Mobile (< 768px): Stack all sections vertically, single column layouts, hamburger menu
Tablet (768px - 1024px): 2-column grids where applicable, optimized touch targets
Desktop (> 1024px): Full bento grids, split layouts, optimal reading width
ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS (GSAP):
Hero: Fade in + slide up on page load
All sections: Fade in on scroll using ScrollTrigger (trigger when 20% visible)
Bento cards: Staggered entrance (0.1-0.15s delay between each)
Accordion: Smooth height + opacity transition (0.3s ease)
Hover states: Scale (1.02-1.05) + glow effect
Countdown timers: Smooth number flip transitions
Stock ticker: Continuous horizontal scroll (infinite loop)
Parallax: Background elements move slower than foreground (0.5-0.7 speed)
PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS:
Lazy load images and videos
Optimize YouTube embeds (load on click, not page load)
Use Next.js Image component for all images
Minimize bundle size
Fast initial page load (< 3s)
ACCESSIBILITY:
Proper heading hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3)
Alt text for all images
Keyboard navigation support
ARIA labels for interactive elements
Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards

Create a professional live enrollment notification widget for an educational course website with the following requirements:

PROJECT OVERVIEW:
Build a floating notification popup that displays real-time enrollment messages to create urgency and social proof. The widget should appear in the bottom-left corner of the screen.

DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:

1. NOTIFICATION BOX STYLING:
   - Modern card design with subtle shadow
   - White background with rounded corners (8px border-radius)
   - Maximum width: 380px
   - Padding: 16px 20px
   - Smooth slide-in animation from left
   - Position: fixed, bottom-left (20px from bottom, 20px from left)
   - Z-index: 9999 to appear above all content

2. NOTIFICATION CONTENT LAYOUT:
   - Icon on the left (emoji or icon: ✅, 🎉, 🔥, ⚠️, 🎯, ✨)
   - Main text in the middle (2-3 lines)
   - Close button (×) on the right
   - Time stamp at the bottom in smaller, gray text
   - Optional: Small avatar/profile icon next to main text

3. VISUAL ELEMENTS:
   - Font: Clean sans-serif (Inter, Poppins, or system font)
   - Primary text: #2c3e50, font-size 14px, font-weight 600
   - Secondary text: #7f8c8d, font-size 12px
   - Icon size: 28px
   - Smooth fade-in/fade-out transitions
   - Subtle hover effect on close button

4. NOTIFICATION TYPES TO ROTATE:

   Type 1 - Engagement:
   "🎊 Congratulations! You're viewing this while 8 others are too. 3 of them will enroll. Will you?"
   
   Type 2 - Milestone:
   "🎯 MILESTONE: 32nd student just enrolled! The next 18 students get a special bonus!"
   
   Type 3 - Trending:
   "🔥 TRENDING: This batch is filling 5 times faster than usual. Don't miss out!"
   
   Type 4 - Progress:
   "✨ 50% FILLED: Half the batch is already gone. Secure your spot now!"
   
   Type 5 - Recent Activity:
   "⚡ 5 people enrolled in the last 2 hours. Only 12 seats remaining!"
   
   Type 6 - Time Pressure:
   "⏰ ALERT: 18 students viewing right now. 12 seats left. Act fast!"
   
   Type 7 - Social Proof:
   "👥 127 people visited this page today. 23 already enrolled. Join them!"
   
   Type 8 - Scarcity:
   "⚠️ URGENT: Last 10 seats filling up fast! 3 enrollments in the last hour!"

5. FUNCTIONALITY:

   A. Display Timing:
      - First notification appears 15 seconds after page load
      - Each notification displays for 6 seconds
      - Random interval between notifications: 3-6 minutes
      - Rotate through all 8 notification types randomly
      - Stop showing after 6 notifications per session
   
   B. Animations:
      - Slide in from left with fade-in (0.5s ease-out)
      - Slide out to left with fade-out (0.4s ease-in)
      - Smooth transition between show/hide states
   
   C. User Interaction:
      - Close button (×) to dismiss current notification
      - Clicking anywhere on notification (optional) could link to pricing section
      - Once closed, wait for next interval before showing new notification
   
   D. Session Management:
      - Track how many notifications shown using sessionStorage
      - Don't show notifications to users who've already seen 6
      - Reset counter on new browser session

6. MOBILE RESPONSIVENESS:
   - On screens below 768px width:
     * Position: bottom-right instead of bottom-left
     * Width: calc(100% - 40px)
     * Bottom position: 80px (to avoid sticky CTAs)
     * Smaller font: 13px for main text, 11px for timestamp
     * Reduce padding to 12px 16px
   - Ensure touch-friendly close button (minimum 44x44px tap target)

7. ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
   - Randomize which notification shows (no fixed order)
   - Add subtle pulse animation every 3 seconds when visible
   - Optional: Add progress bar at bottom showing batch fill status
   - Optional: Add "View Details →" link button below main text

8. CODE STRUCTURE:
   - Use vanilla JavaScript (no external libraries)
   - Clean, commented code
   - CSS should be inline or in <style> tag
   - All in single HTML file for easy deployment
   - Use modern ES6+ JavaScript features
   - Ensure no console errors

9. COLOR SCHEME:
   - Background: #ffffff
   - Border: 1px solid #e0e0e0
   - Shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
   - Icon colors: Use emoji or CSS colored icons
   - Text: #2c3e50 (dark gray)
   - Timestamp: #95a5a6 (light gray)
   - Close button hover: #e74c3c (red)

10. ACCESSIBILITY:
    - Proper ARIA labels
    - Keyboard accessible (ESC to close)
    - Screen reader friendly
    - Sufficient color contrast
    - Focus states for interactive elements

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
- Single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript
- No external dependencies
- Cross-browser compatible (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- Lightweight (under 10KB total)
- No jQuery or other libraries
- Works on HTTP and HTTPS
- No backend required (pure frontend)

DELIVERABLE:
Provide complete, production-ready HTML code that I can copy and paste into my website. Include clear comments explaining each section. The code should be fully functional and require zero modifications to work.

BONUS FEATURES (if possible):
- Smooth number counter animation for "X students enrolled"
- Subtle confetti animation on milestone notifications
- Sound effect option (muted by default)
- Dark mode variant
- Option to pause notifications on hover

Please generate clean, well-documented code that looks professional and increases conversion rates through strategic social proof and urgency messaging.
